title: Winding Stair Campground

services.name: Campground Amenities
services.desc: All guests have full access to all amenities and communal areas on the Campground. Our heated Bathhouse has separate men’s and women’s sides, each with heaters, 3 sinks, 4 flushing toilets, 2 showers with private changing areas, and hot water. The Bathhouse is shared with all other campers. We provide shampoo and soap. Just bring your own towels! We provide an NC-made, biodegradable soap and shampoo, called Fillaree, that is river-safe and made from all-natural ingredients. Forget something? For your convenience, our Honesty Store is located above the Bathhouse and includes firewood, ice, local meats, ice cream, toothbrushes, stickers, sweatshirts, and more. We also have maps and guidebooks

services.name: Glamping Sites
services.desc: Whether you’re looking for glamping in Franklin or a comfortable base camp for exploring the region, we’ve got you covered. Our glamping options provide the perfect balance between outdoor adventure and creature comforts. Enjoy hot showers in our spotless bathhouse, fire pits, picnic areas, even electricity at select glamping sites, while surrounded by the natural beauty of the Appalachian Mountains. 40 minutes from Highlands NC, Sylva NC30 minutes from Hayesville NC40 minutes from Clayton GA We’re perfectly positioned for day trips to waterfalls, hiking trails, gem mining, and mountain town exploring. services.name: Group Lane
services.desc: This large, single site has 4 double-sided RV hook-ups (220v & 110v) plus 4 potable water yard hydrants, set along a central road in the middle of our Campground in the Smoky Mountains. Whether you’re planning a family reunion campsite or a getaway with friends, this flexible space is built to accommodate it all. Mix it up, this site can accommodate tents, small RV’s, car camping, and hammocks. One flat rental rate covers the entire site, which is centrally located between the Bathhouse and communal Pavilion. Great for glamping groups, car campers, or mixed camping setups - you don’t have to choose just one style. Group Lane has its own gathering space. This includes an XL Breeo fire pit

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: This is a private tour with the owners (Greg and Stacy) of our water-powered Grist Mill at the original Mountain Farm. For one Sunday each summer, Winding Stair hosts a free open house at the Campground. The gates are open-bring a packed lunch, relax by the river, explore our camping and glamping sites, visit our flock of Icelandic sheep, and see our free range turkeys, ducks, chickens, and guineas. Tour our working, water-powered Grist Mill. Held just after lambing season, this private tour invites you to explore the Mountain Livestock Farm with owners Greg and Stacy, as well as our Campground and Livestock managers.
